notes.title: PATCH 1.18
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome, Exiles, to a New Patch! 🌟[/h1]

With Patch 1.18, there are lots of exciting updates in the game! 

[h2]New in-game mode[/h2]

The biggest is the new Assault mode, where you can infiltrate enemy forts, kill as many enemies as possible before time runs out ⏳, and steal their flag! 🚩 Assaults offer treasures in much larger quantities than Objectives! 💰

🗺️Plus, you can upgrade your map with the vendor using Rubies 💎 to unlock a premium version of Assault. In this mode, you'll earn Sapphires instead of Treasures!  The Assault mode is live now!

[h2]Seasonal leaderboards[/h2]

👑And now for your favorite part of the season — Leaderboards! 👑

Earn lots of rewards for placing high! This version of the leaderboards ties into our Exiles Run event, meaning your leaderboard placements will be [b]converted into event XP[/b]! At the end of the event, this XP will be exchanged for discord rewards! 🏆

✨[b]Curious about how the competition and scoring will work?[/b]
[list]
[*] Highest Stage in Grindzone
[*] Number of Bosses Killed*
[*] Number of Daily Quests Completed
[*] Number of Objectives Completed
[*] Number of Monsters Killed
[*] Number of Assaults Completed
[/list]⚔️This season, we added more leaderboards for different activities and streamlined the boss leaderboard into one, adding boss points. Each boss gives different points, affecting your ranking!

🛡️For each [b]Cave Boss killed[/b], you will earn the following points on the 'Number of Bosses Killed' leaderboard:
[list]
[*] Frozen Golem - 60
[*] Mushfather - 75
[*] Kingfrog - 80
[*] Dryad of Decay - 90
[*] Patriarch - 105
[*] Shadow Prince - 110
[/list]So, spend your lanterns wisely!⚡️

[b]🕹️Each leaderboard offers up to 2300 XP points for the top 10 spots, with 425 XP for first place![/b]

⏰Leaderboards are weekly and refresh every Monday at midnight (CET). 

👾Track your leaderboard progress on the special channel on [url=https://discord.gg/gUv6yspqwk]Discord[/url]!

[b]Join the game and take on the challenge today! ⚔️[/b]

notes.title: Patch 1.5.1
notes.content:
[h2]Save[/h2]
Old, incompatible saves are deleted when you start the game.

[h2]News[/h2]

[h3]Kupiec[/h3][list]
[*] The Merchant building in the Hideout has been unlocked.
[*] Merchant interface added.
[*] Added offer objects.
[*] Added bid tab.
[*] Added scaled item prices.
[*] Added Mysterious Items, the purchase of which adds a random item from the group to the player.
[/list]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
[list]
[*] Receiving rewards for progression in the game.
[*] Ability to receive raw materials.
[*] Changed droprate to lower.
[/list]
[h3]Victory & Defeat[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mission Objectives. Added objective type - Defeat X enemies.
[*]Victory and Defeat Conditions.
[*]Victory & Defeat screen[/list]

[h3]Battlefield[/h3]
[list]
[*]Monster death events trigger instantly, speeding up mission progress and naturally spawning loot.
[/list]
[h3]Sounds and music[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sound of making a purchase in Vendor[/list]

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added marking of a more powerful item in the clipboard than the one currently worn.
[*] Received rewards from achievements and purchases appear in the corner of the screen.
[*] Upon entering the game for the first time, an open Welcome screen will greet you.
[*] Information on keyboard shortcuts has been added to the game.
[*]Added keyboard shortcut to change attack/defense/passive mode[/list]
[h2]Fixed Bugs[/h2]

[list]
[*] The restart button (which should never have been there and was potentially problematic for other game modes) was removed from Mission Summary.
[*] After a victory, the number of monsters killed in the summarcy screen and the amount of game time was 0.
[*] The hero, after using an offensive attack ability within range of an indestructible object, could start attacking the indestructible object.
[/list]

Thank you for all the submissions! Thanks to you, our game becomes better.
If you have found a bug or would like to share your thoughts about Shelter of Exiles - welcome to our Discord:
[b]Discord:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/fz2TxETGQs]https://discord.gg/fz2TxETGQs[/url]
